'''2024 Champions League''' was the Players Committee Champions League knockout on GEMP, December 2024 to February 2025. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] won the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2024-12-champions-league-dec-2024-feb-2025/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' GEMP
* '''Dates:''' December 2024 – February 2025
